problems: The blind guess ('loose pale blue curves, no clear object') does not identify a kite. The blue outline is a narrow teardrop loop around the upper group, not a recognisable kite silhouette.
The gold lines carry the shape. They form a thin wireframe of triangles from the stars rather than a filled or outlined kite body, so the figure reads as a stick diagram, not a silhouette.

The kite is upright (apex 110538 at top, tail running down-right), and the stars sit roughly on the right parts: apex 110538 (232,108), left wingtip 111674 (179,124), right wingtip 110609 (228,177), bottom corner 111022 (207,221), lamp 111169 (202,157) near the centre, knot 110351 (242,251), lantern 109102 (309,287).

The lamp label and the right-wingtip label sit on top of the gold lines and each other. The top-apex label is clipped at the right edge ('the he'), and the left-wingtip label is crossed by the apex-to-wing line.
The figure occupies only about 200x200 px of a 530x555 frame, so the kite and its tail are cramped in the upper-left of the sky.
output.advice: Redraw so the kite reads as a silhouette, not a wireframe. (1) Draw one closed, filled pale-blue kite outline through 110538 (232,108) at the top, 111674 (179,124) left, 110609 (228,177) right, and 111022 (207,221) at the bottom. Keep the kite's sides straight and the left/right wings slightly wider than the apex-to-bottom axis, so it reads as a diamond kite, not a teardrop. (2) Put 111169 (202,157), the lamp, as a small bright lozenge or glow at the centre of that outline, not as a gold triangle fan. (3) Draw the tail as a single thin curve from 111022 (207,221) through the knot 110351 (242,251) to the lantern 109102 (309,287). Draw the lantern as a small ring around 109102, as now. (4) Reduce the gold lines to a thin guide or remove them, so the blue silhouette is the main shape. (5) Scale the whole figure up about 1.6x around its centre, to fill more of the frame. (6) Move each label off the stars with a short leader line, placed outside the figure on the left or right. Keep the top-apex label inside the frame so it is not clipped.
